_readme: Eval fixtures for M1. Image files are git-ignored (the repo is public). People: s01-s09 are AI-generated fictional people (see generatedBy), phone-style captures; s06 and s08 are the same identity. monkTone values are eyeballed estimates. wearing fills the prompt's [CURRENT_ITEM]; garment description fills [TARGET_GARMENT_DESCRIPTION]. Garments: 6 VITON-HD tops (CC BY-NC 4.0) + 14 Wikimedia Commons items (CC0/PD/CC BY/CC BY-SA); credits in garments/ATTRIBUTION.md, reasoning in docs/decisions/0002-eval-fixture-sources.md.

garments.probes: Saturated solid colour, plain tee. Colour-fidelity baseline; the easiest case.
garments.description: green crew-neck t-shirt

garments.probes: Bold block-letter logo. Text is a known image-model failure; do the letters survive every pose?
garments.description: blue t-shirt with a large black-and-white DKNY logo

garments.probes: Dense multi-colour floral, sleeveless. Busy-pattern fidelity; pattern scale.
garments.description: sleeveless top with a dense multicolour floral print

garments.probes: Sheer polka-dot tie-front top. Material fidelity (transparency); may also trip safety filters, which is itself a finding.
garments.description: sheer black polka-dot top with short sleeves and a tie front

garments.probes: Black wrap bodysuit with ruffles and bell sleeves. Detail loss on black; complex structure.
garments.description: black wrap bodysuit with ruffles and bell sleeves

garments.probes: Near-white open-knit crochet. Low contrast against skin and a white background; open texture.
garments.description: cream open-knit crochet short-sleeve top

garments.probes: Brown herringbone knit sweater with suede elbow patches. Knit texture; patch placement changes with arm position across poses.
garments.description: brown knit crew-neck sweater with suede elbow patches

garments.probes: Short-sleeve madras plaid shirt, men's cut. Plaid alignment at seams and placket; a men's garment on the current (women) fixtures.
garments.description: short-sleeve pink, blue and white madras plaid shirt

garments.probes: Dark raw-denim straight-leg jeans with hang tags still attached (source crop removed a museum caption). Waistband, pockets, contrast stitching; will the tags be rendered? Low-res (790 px).
garments.description: dark raw-denim straight-leg jeans

garments.probes: Navy tailored trousers, shown on a torso form. Crease and drape on a dark colour; the form's bare torso must not be copied.
garments.description: navy tailored straight-leg trousers

garments.probes: Leopard-print skinny trousers. Pattern fidelity on a bottom; pattern scale. Low-res (582 px).
garments.description: leopard-print skinny trousers

garments.probes: Burgundy track pants with white side stripes, on a creased sheet. Stripe continuity across poses (walking, seated).
garments.description: burgundy track pants with white side stripes

garments.probes: Blue satin dress with a pearl-bead neckline. Sheen and highlights; bead detail. Low-res (923 px).
garments.description: blue satin dress with a pearl-bead neckline

garments.probes: Dark green shift dress, three-quarter sleeves, pale belt, on a museum mannequin (grey background). Belt placement; sleeve length; mannequin must not be copied.
garments.description: dark green shift dress with three-quarter sleeves and a pale belt

garments.probes: Knitted dress in wide horizontal bands (black, cream, pink), on a museum mannequin. Band order, count and width across poses; seated pose distorts bands.
garments.description: knitted short-sleeve dress in wide black, cream and pink horizontal bands

garments.probes: Hooded technical shell/windbreaker, stiff synthetic, flat lay (transparent PNG flattened to white). The learning-log hypothesis: does a stiff shell render as soft, clingy fabric?
garments.description: grey-green hooded technical shell jacket

garments.probes: Bright blue nylon windbreaker with magenta zip and trim and a small embroidered logo. Saturated synthetic colour; thin contrast trim; logo.
garments.description: bright blue nylon windbreaker with magenta zip and trim

garments.probes: Acid-wash cropped denim jacket on a dress form (grey background), with small patches. Wash texture; cropped length. Low-res (757 px).
garments.description: light acid-wash cropped denim jacket

garments.probes: Olive parka with fur-trimmed hood, mid-thigh length. Bulk and length; fur texture. Low-res (750 px).
garments.description: olive parka with a fur-trimmed hood

garments.probes: Black leather car coat, museum piece, flat. Leather sheen on black; detail loss on black.
garments.description: black leather car coat
